algorithm_signals.name: click_through_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Percentage of impressions that result in a click. Thumbnail + title combination is the primary driver.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Target 8-12% CTR for Shorts, 4-8% for long-form. Use curiosity gaps, bold text overlays, and expressive faces in thumbnails. Split-test 3 thumbnails per video.

algorithm_signals.name: average_percentage_viewed
algorithm_signals.description: Average fraction of the video watched. The single most important retention signal for YouTube's recommendation engine.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Target >70% for Shorts, >50% for long-form. Front-load value, use pattern interrupts every 30-60s, add open loops. Drop-off spikes usually occur at intros >15s.

algorithm_signals.name: session_watch_time
algorithm_signals.description: Total watch time a viewer accumulates on the platform after watching your video. YouTube rewards content that keeps users on-platform.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use end screens linking to playlists. Suggest next video verbally. Chain Shorts into series. Avoid external links in first 24 hours.

algorithm_signals.name: browse_feature_ctr
algorithm_signals.description: Click-through rate specifically from the Browse (homepage) feature. Determines homepage promotion eligibility.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Clean thumbnails with 3 or fewer text words, high contrast, close-up faces. Titles under 60 characters with a number or emotional word.

algorithm_signals.name: subscriber_conversion
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of non-subscribers who subscribe after watching. Signals content quality and channel value proposition.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Include a subscribe CTA between 40-60% through the video (when engagement is proven). Avoid generic CTAs — tie to specific value.

algorithm_signals.name: comment_velocity
algorithm_signals.description: Number of comments received in the first 1-2 hours after publish. Signals audience engagement to the recommendation algorithm.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Ask a specific question in the last 15 seconds. Pin a controversial or curiosity-provoking first comment. Reply to every comment in the first hour.

algorithm_signals.name: like_to_view_ratio
algorithm_signals.description: Ratio of likes relative to view count. Secondary quality signal behind retention.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Target >5% like ratio. Deliver an 'aha' moment in the first 30 seconds. Emotional payoff increases like probability.

algorithm_signals.name: share_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Number of shares via platform share button, DMs, and external links. High-value signal indicating content worth spreading.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Create 'I need to show this to someone' moments. Relatable humor, surprising facts, and useful tutorials get shared most.

algorithm_signals.name: completion_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Percentage of viewers who watch the video to the end. The single most important signal in TikTok's For You algorithm.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Keep videos under 30s for highest completion. Hook in first 0.5s. Use cliffhanger endings that loop seamlessly. Target >80% completion for viral potential.

algorithm_signals.name: rewatch_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Percentage of viewers who replay the video. Multiplied with completion rate to form TikTok's core engagement score.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Hide details that require rewatching. Use fast transitions. End with a twist that recontextualizes the beginning. Text overlays viewers need to pause for.

algorithm_signals.name: share_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of shares to DMs, other platforms, and copy-link actions. TikTok's strongest 'quality' signal for pushing to broader audiences.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Create content people tag friends in. Duet/stitch-bait formats. 'Send this to someone who...' hooks. Tutorials people save for later.

algorithm_signals.name: save_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of users bookmarking the video. Indicates long-term value and pushes content to the Explore algorithm.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Educational content, recipes, tutorials, and life hacks get saved most. Add 'Save this for later' CTA. Multi-step content drives saves.

algorithm_signals.name: sound_usage
algorithm_signals.description: Whether the video uses a trending sound and whether others subsequently use your original sound.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use trending sounds within 48 hours of trend emergence. Original sounds that get reused signal creator authority. Mix trending audio with original voiceover.

algorithm_signals.name: initial_engagement_velocity
algorithm_signals.description: Speed of engagement (likes, comments, shares) in the first 30-60 minutes. Determines whether TikTok pushes the video to larger batch audiences.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Post when core audience is active. Engage with comments immediately. First 200-500 views are the 'test batch' — optimize for these. Controversial hooks spike velocity.

algorithm_signals.name: comment_sentiment
algorithm_signals.description: Natural language analysis of comment sentiment and substantiveness. Longer, positive comments weight higher than emoji-only replies.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Ask open-ended questions. Create debate-worthy content. Reply with follow-up questions to extend threads. Pin a comment that encourages discussion.

algorithm_signals.name: profile_visit_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of viewers who visit your profile after watching. Signals creator interest and funnel potential.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Leave a curiosity gap about who you are. Series content ('Part 1 of...') drives profile visits. Strong personal brand elements in video.

algorithm_signals.name: save_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of saves/bookmarks. Instagram's most heavily weighted engagement signal, indicating content has lasting value.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Educational carousels, infographics, and quote graphics get saved most. Add 'Save for later' CTA. Provide actionable takeaways.

algorithm_signals.name: share_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of DM shares and story reshares. Second most important signal after saves for Explore page eligibility.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Create memes, relatable content, and tag-a-friend worthy posts. Controversial opinions drive shares. Keep carousels shareable by making slide 1 a standalone hook.

algorithm_signals.name: carousel_completion_rate
algorithm_signals.description: For carousel posts, the percentage of users who swipe through all slides. Equivalent to watch time for Reels.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use 7-10 slides for optimal completion. Slide 1 is the hook, slide 2 is 'swipe for more', last slide is CTA. Each slide must add value — no filler.

algorithm_signals.name: reel_replay_rate
algorithm_signals.description: How often Reels are replayed. Key signal for Reels algorithm ranking, similar to TikTok's rewatch rate.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Keep Reels under 15s for highest replay. Use seamless loops. Dense information that requires rewatching. Satisfying visual transitions.

algorithm_signals.name: hashtag_relevance
algorithm_signals.description: Topical relevance of hashtags to content. Instagram now uses hashtags as topic classifiers, not discovery tools.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use 3-5 highly relevant hashtags. Mix 1 broad (1M+), 2 medium (100K-1M), 2 niche (<100K). Avoid banned or spammy hashtags. Place in caption, not comments.

algorithm_signals.name: time_spent_on_post
algorithm_signals.description: Dwell time on the post. Longer viewing indicates interest and quality. Applies to all content types.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Long captions with storytelling increase dwell time. Detailed infographic carousels. Reels with text overlays that take time to read.

algorithm_signals.name: comment_depth
algorithm_signals.description: Quality and depth of comments — threaded conversations weight more than single emoji comments.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Ask polarizing questions. Share vulnerable stories that invite responses. Reply with substantive comments to create threads. Use question stickers in Stories.

algorithm_signals.name: follow_rate_from_content
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of new followers gained from a specific piece of content. Signals the content attracts new audience.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Strong branded intro slides. Value-packed content that makes users want more. Clear niche positioning. 'Follow for more [topic]' CTA on final slide.

algorithm_signals.name: reply_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of replies relative to impressions. X's algorithm heavily favors tweets that generate conversation.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Ask direct questions. Share hot takes with room for nuance. Use 'What's your take?' or 'Unpopular opinion:' formats. Reply to your own tweet to seed conversation.

algorithm_signals.name: retweet_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of retweets (including quote tweets). Primary distribution mechanism on X for reaching beyond followers.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Actionable tips, data insights, and controversial-but-defensible opinions get retweeted most. Thread hooks that promise a story. Timely commentary on trending topics.

algorithm_signals.name: bookmark_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of bookmarks. X has publicly stated bookmarks are a strong ranking signal — they indicate value without social pressure.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: How-to threads, resource lists, and data-backed insights get bookmarked. Add 'Bookmark this thread' at the end. Make content reference-worthy.

algorithm_signals.name: dwell_time
algorithm_signals.description: Time spent viewing a tweet before scrolling past. Applies to text, images, and video. Longer dwell = higher interest signal.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use images with dense information. Long-form tweets (280 chars) with line breaks. Thread format for storytelling. Embed charts and screenshots.

algorithm_signals.name: quote_tweet_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of quote tweets. Weighted higher than retweets because they create new discussion nodes in the graph.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Share opinions that people want to add commentary to. Data without analysis invites quote tweets. 'Here's what most people get wrong about...' format.

algorithm_signals.name: profile_click_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of profile visits from a tweet. Indicates the content made users curious about the author.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Include credentials or contrarian positioning. 'I spent 10 years doing X, here's what I learned' format. Strong voice and personality in tweets.

algorithm_signals.name: link_click_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of clicks on embedded links. Lower weight because X de-prioritizes external links in the algorithm.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Put links in the first reply, not the main tweet. Use text-only tweets for reach, link tweets for conversion. If linking, front-load the value proposition.

algorithm_signals.name: follower_engagement_ratio
algorithm_signals.description: Engagement from followers vs non-followers. High non-follower engagement indicates broad appeal.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Participate in trending conversations. Use 1-2 relevant hashtags on X. Create standalone tweets that don't require following context.

algorithm_signals.name: dwell_time
algorithm_signals.description: Time spent reading or viewing a post. LinkedIn's most important signal — long-form text and document posts benefit most.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Write 1200-1500 character posts with line breaks. Use the 'hook → story → insight → CTA' format. Document (PDF carousel) posts get 3x more dwell time than text.

algorithm_signals.name: comment_depth
algorithm_signals.description: Quality, length, and threading of comments. Multi-reply conversations signal content that sparks professional dialogue.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: End every post with a genuine question. Reply to every comment with a thoughtful follow-up question. Tag relevant people who might add expert perspective.

algorithm_signals.name: share_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of reshares to personal networks. Extends reach to 2nd and 3rd degree connections.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Industry insights, career advice, and contrarian professional opinions get shared. Data-driven posts with original analysis. Avoid overly promotional content.

algorithm_signals.name: document_view_completion
algorithm_signals.description: For document (PDF carousel) posts, the percentage of slides viewed. LinkedIn's equivalent of watch time.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Use 8-12 slides with large text. Slide 1 is the hook, slide 2 is 'swipe →'. Each slide should have one key point. End with a summary + CTA slide.

algorithm_signals.name: click_through_rate
algorithm_signals.description: Rate of clicks on links or 'see more' button. Lower weight because LinkedIn deprioritizes external links.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Put links in the first comment, not the post body. Use 'link in comments' CTA. Native content (no external links) gets 3-5x more reach.

algorithm_signals.name: reaction_diversity
algorithm_signals.description: Variety of reactions (like, celebrate, support, love, insightful, funny). Diverse reactions signal content that resonates emotionally.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Share wins for 'celebrate', vulnerable stories for 'support', data insights for 'insightful'. Varied emotional tone across posts.

algorithm_signals.name: early_engagement_velocity
algorithm_signals.description: Engagement in the first 60-90 minutes. LinkedIn tests posts with a small audience segment first before broader distribution.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Post when your network is active (typically 8-10 AM local). Engage with others for 15 min before posting. Reply to all comments within 1 hour.

algorithm_signals.name: connection_relevance
algorithm_signals.description: How relevant the content is to your connections' stated interests and industry. Determined by topic classification.
algorithm_signals.optimization_notes: Stay consistent with your professional niche. Use industry-specific terminology. LinkedIn classifies posts into topics — be clearly in one lane.
